## Introduction

In this research, I analyze the impact of international commodity prices on local social conflicts. This project utilizes the `usecasen` and `enahodata` tools I developed to streamline data processing.

::: {.callout-econometrics}
**Identification Strategy**: We use a Difference-in-Differences (DiD) approach combined with Spatial Econometrics to account for spillover effects between districts.
:::
